text: Handling deadlines is a skill that can greatly reduce stress in both work and study. Good time management starts with breaking a large task into smaller, daily steps, so you are never overwhelmed at the last minute. Prioritization is equally important: identify which tasks are urgent and which can wait, and focus your energy on the most critical parts first. Effective scope management means being honest about what is realistic to achieve, and sometimes saying no to extra requests. Finally, clear communication with your team or your teacher ensures that everyone understands the timeline. If you face a problem, speak up early. A small, honest conversation is far better than missing the final date.
